first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building, directly bound to explicit building type/use evidence. Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local FunctionalSite specification binds classification, distinctiveName and siteTheme to polygon geometry, but defines that geometry as the extent of the functional site rather than a physical building footprint. The selected public no-login specification window also exposes no single Exeter feature payload or footprint coordinates. Source-area/schema evidence was therefore inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
method_change: Historic England NHLE exact-record FeatureServer polygon query -> Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local FunctionalSite official technical-specification semantic validation; different publisher/data family/protocol, testing geometry semantics before record acceptance.
